# Catalogue

> A catalogue of things — companies, projects, sites — as plain JSON, typed
> with schema.org.

Everything below is authoritative and machine-readable. Fetch the JSON, do not
scrape the HTML.

- Manifest: https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/index.json
- Things: brisecom
- Datasets per thing: organization, people, services, promotions, sites
- Format: JSON, `@context: https://schema.org`
- License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
- Last modified: 2026-11-19

## How to query

1. `GET https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/index.json` — a `DataCatalog`; `dataset[]` lists the things.
2. Pick a thing by `identifier` (e.g. `brisecom`).
3. Read `https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/things/brisecom/index.json` — its `DataCatalog`.
4. Fetch any dataset, or one service at a time:
   `https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/things/brisecom/services/<id>.json`.

## Datasets

| Dataset | Type | Holds |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `organization.json` | `Organization` | Legal identity, VAT, address, founder |
| `people.json` | `ItemList` of `Person` | People, with ORCID |
| `services.json` | `OfferCatalog` of `Service` | Prices, durations |
| `promotions.json` | `ItemList` of `PromotionalOffer` | Offers; honour `validUntil` |
| `sites.json` | `ItemList` of `WebSite` | Sites the thing operates |
